Careers at BlueGreen Water Technologies:

Make Water Safe. Make a Difference.

Join a Mission That Matters

At BlueGreen Water Technologies, we're not just building a company; we're building a healthier planet. We are a global leader in restoring and protecting water bodies, developing and deploying innovative solutions to combat climate change and harmful algal blooms. Our mission is clear: to restore the health and safety of water bodies worldwide, preserving biodiversity, supporting thriving ecosystems, and promoting sustainable economic growth. 

Beyond the Ordinary

Why BlueGreen?

We offer a unique opportunity to work with proven, patented technology that delivers real, tangible environmental change. At BlueGreen, your efforts directly contribute to innovative solutions that are actively restoring vital water bodies and addressing critical global challenges. Join a team where your work truly makes a difference.

Our Global Culture

Innovation, Impact & Belonging

At BlueGreen, we foster a dynamic, friendly, and supportive environment where every voice is valued and respected. We believe in open communication and collaboration, ensuring you're part of something greater than the sum of its parts.

Our Core Values Guide Us

Lead the way with cutting-edge science, technology,  professionalism and multi-disciplinary expertise

Simply, get it done through outcomes

Care for the environment, care for people (A healthy and safe planet)

Challenge the dogma, always (Data-driven innovation, creativity)

Integrity in everything we do

Growth & Development: Your Future Here
We are deeply committed to your professional and personal growth. At the heart of our culture is continuous learning, open communication, and meaningful support, empowering you to thrive and evolve in your career.

Purpose-Driven Leadership: Our leadership is focused on supporting individuals and teams aligned around meaningful goals. Employees feel their work truly matters and have a strong voice in shaping our culture. We build trust through high engagement, ongoing feedback, and impactful development opportunities.

Performance Assessment – OKR Method: We set clear, measurable goals and provide regular feedback to support continuous improvement and recognition of your achievements.

Advanced Learning & Development Tools: We invest in your growth with cutting-edge resources, including advanced AI technologies, to help you expand your skills and reach your full potential.

Conferences & Cross-Training: Stay sharp and expand your horizons through access to industry events and hands-on learning across disciplines.

Collaborative Decision-Making: We blend top-down direction with bottom-up input to ensure clarity in roles, strong accountability, transparent communication, and deep trust. This inclusive approach strengthens alignment and decision quality across the organization.

Inclusive Culture and Belonging We foster diverse: Different voices and backgrounds help us work better together, spark new ideas, and achieve great results.
